articles.title: Motorcycle crash near Eglinton West sends 1 woman to hospital
articles.summary: A woman in her 20s was sent to a hospital on Saturday afternoon following a motorcycle crash in the Eglinton West neighbourhood. Emergency crews were called to the Eglinton Avenue West and Keele Street area just after 12:30 p.m. Authorities said the crash involved a motorcycle and another vehicle. articles.title: East-end home evacuated after fire breaks out
articles.summary: Emergency crews were called to a residential home in the east-end early Saturday morning for reports of a house fire. The blaze was reported near Gerrard Street East and Jones Avenue shortly before 8 a.m. Authorities said the residents of the home self-evacuated before firefighters arrived at the scene. articles.title: Durham Region to hold 1st community event celebrating newcomers on Saturday
articles.summary: Durham Region is hosting its first community event on Saturday to celebrate the contributions newcomers make to the region.

articles.title: Man seriously wounded in Scarborough shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for at least one suspect after a man was critically wounded in a shooting in Scarborough on Friday night.

articles.title: Mississauga's top mayoral candidates face off in 1st debate
articles.summary: Mississauga's top issues were up for debate Friday when the leading mayoral candidates faced off ahead of the October election.

articles.title: Parents want change as Ajax students face hours-long bus commute every day
articles.summary: Parents in Ajax are frustrated over a change to a school bus route that has their children spending over two hours on the road every day.

articles.title: Police identify woman, 72, killed in Scarborough hospital parking lot
articles.summary: Police have identified a 72-year-old woman shot dead in a Scarborough hospital parking lot this week as Karen Swatogor.

Other locals pointed to parking shortages, while some had no complaints at all. articles.title: This couple says they are paying the price of Toronto's housing push
articles.summary: An elderly downtown couple says they’re shocked and upset that the city has approved a duplex next door to their three-story Victorian home that they say will tower metres above their chimney and render their fireplaces useless while blocking one window.

articles.title: 3 big moments from the first Mississauga mayoral debate
articles.summary: Four Mississauga mayoral candidates — incumbent Carolyn Parrish, former mayor Bonnie Crombie and councillors Dipika Damerla and Alvin Tedjo — sparred over police budgets, data centres and municipal track records in the first election debate of the campaign.

articles.title: Mamdani's populist style is all over the Toronto election race
articles.summary: Zohran Mamdani's 2025 mayoral campaign put a spotlight on cost of living issues and was characterized by colourful messaging, snappy social media videos and a where-there’s-a-will-there’s-a-way approach to making changes in New York — tactics many candidates in Toronto’s municipal election seem to be replicating.
